# sweep_2x2.py verifies both sims at preflight and every phase entry.  Cells at pins 1–6 were
# CRAQ-gated by the earlier f80a8d64 sim (recorded here, not silently rewritten).
# ERRATA (2026-08-17, Lane AW — the errata IS the repair; no measured value is changed here):
#   E1  HEADER NEGLECT (waves 5–6 V1): from pin 4 (9827aaac…) through pin 6 (a45dbca5…) this
#       header kept naming pin 3 (afe05a86…) as the CURRENT PINNED_CC1PLUS_SHA256 anchor

#       a77bc22d72, 8c1a9af0-adjacent bookings) without repairing its own must-agree rule.
#   E2  SELF-FALSIFIED SENTENCE (wave 6 V1): commit a77bc22d72 overwrote the exact
#       unarymaxmin-max/min sem_on cells (23.84 → 15.0889, pin-6 refresh) while this header's
#       own sentence still said those cells "remain the reviewed record until that [pin-3 flip
#       triage] decision" — a triage that had in fact been RESOLVED at pin 4 and never recorded
#       here.  The sentence was left standing in the same commit that falsified it.
#   E3  RETRACTION: the pre-a77bc22d72 unarymaxmin "semantic BEATS hand -12.70%" row is
#       DO-NOT-CITE (nightly-20260816b flagged its causal WIN→LOSS FLIP under pin 3; the cells
#       were then superseded by the pin-6 refresh).  The citable unarymaxmin numbers are the
#       pin-6 same-run cells below (see E5 for their validity evidence).
#   E4  UNITS (recorded, not changed): for marker=TILE_LOOP rows the post-CSV mean(...) is
#       ALREADY per-tile (tests/python_tests/helpers/perf/core.py postprocess_tile_loop divides
#       by loop_factor*tile_cnt); sweep_2x2.py's _perf_value divides by tile_cnt AGAIN.  Every
#       TILE_LOOP cell below is therefore (true cycles/tile)/tile_cnt — e.g. unarymaxmin sem_on
#       15.0889 = 120.711 true cycles/tile / 8.  The convention is uniform across cells, so
#       every booked ratio (causal, vs-hand, drift) is unaffected; issue_slot_lb values in
#       sweep_2x2_ops.tsv are booked in these same recorded units.  Rebooking all TILE_LOOP
#       cells ×tile_cnt to true per-tile units is an owner decision (one reviewed commit),
#       deliberately NOT done here.
#   E5  unarymaxmin VALIDITY (wave 6 V3 closed): the pin-6 sem_on cells were booked from a
#       fire-and-forget derived-SFPLOADMACRO shape at marker TILE_LOOP with issue_slot_lb
#       EMPTY.  Repair evidence (nightly-20260817e archives, in-lock CSVs): the formed macro
#       issues 64 SFPLOADMACRO launches + 16 descriptor/config words per tile (dump-derived;
#       4x16 launch loop, ILi32E, templates 0x920009C9/0x940000D6, seq 0x00D50084/0x53000000,
#       misc 0x20) → issue-slot lower bound 80 true cycles/tile = 10 in recorded units.
#       sem_on 15.0889 >= 10 PASS; sem_off 24.211 >= 10; hand 27.312 >= 10.  Drain cross-check
#       from the SAME in-lock run at the drain-inclusive KERNEL marker (deterministic x3):
#       sem_off 25147 / sem_on 15806 / hand 28305 absolute → TILE_LOOP is within 2.3% of the
#       drain-inclusive per-tile figure (123.5 vs 120.7) — NOT a fire-and-forget mismeasure.
#       KERNEL-marker ratios: causal -37.15%, vs-hand -44.16%, confirming the TILE_LOOP
#       -37.68%/-44.75%.  All four unarymaxmin values were re-measured SAME-RUN at pin 6 in
#       nightly-20260817e with values identical to the cells below (hand 27.3115234375 exactly
#       reproduced the stale-pin-1 booking, closing the promised "re-measures under true pin"),
#       so the -44.8% vs-hand headline is single-generation at pin 6 and VALIDATED.
#   E6  ENFORCEMENT: the by-memory rules that allowed E1–E3 are now gates — conf_lint.sh
#       (header/conf/pin-history agreement), REVIEW_RECORD-<pin>.md required by sweep preflight
#       for silicon (HANDOFF §1(4)), issue_slot_lb REQUIRED on macro-launch rows (classify-phase
#       disassembly detection), and the sim sha pins above.
# CROSS-CHIP COMPARABILITY (D5): p150 cells are internally-valid same-source 2x2 pairs, but they
# are NOT same-source with the p100a records: 65d2c873/4ff5c848 changed the measured Min/Max
# kernel's .text for BOTH impls (verified by recompilation), and the chip class changed — every
# "p100a … reproduced" annotation below is a RATIO-LEVEL REPRODUCTION ONLY across a changed
# kernel and chip, never a same-source identity claim.
# expected_class (D4): the op's class-aware acceptance expectation (win/parity/loss/refusal).
# report() gates any transition away from win as RED (including win→byte-identical-refusal) and
# flags refusal→changed as a notice.
# Selector convention for sweep rows: <op>:<cell> with cells sem_off/sem_on/hand_off/hand_on,
# scope <marker>_<metric>_PER_TILE, cycles = mean(<metric>)/tile_cnt in the recorded units of
# E4; the reduce rows keep their native selectors and absolute REDUCE_SDPA_BODY
